errors.generic: Sorry, something went wrong while processing the command. Please try again later.
errors.timeout: The command took too long to process. Please try again.
errors.unknownCommand:
Unknown command *{command}*.
Type *{prefix}help* to see the command list.
errors.maintenance: The bot is in maintenance mode. Please try again later.
errors.modeSelf: The bot is in *self* mode. Only the owner can use commands.
errors.modePrivateGroup: The bot is in *private* mode. In groups, only the owner and group admins can use commands.
errors.modePrivateDirect: The bot is in *private* mode. In private chats, only the owner can use commands.
errors.rateLimit: Too many commands in a short time. Wait *{seconds} seconds* and try again.
errors.groupOnly: This command can only be used in groups.
errors.privateOnly: This command can only be used in private chats.
errors.scope: This command cannot be used in this chat.
errors.banned: You are blocked from using this bot. Contact the owner if you think this is a mistake.

help.description: Show detailed usage for a command

ping.description: Check latency, uptime, and bot status

alive.description: Check whether the bot is online

mode.description: Show or change the bot mode (public/private/self)

welcome.description: Configure the welcome message for new members

goodbye.description: Configure the goodbye message for leaving members

promote.description: Promote a member to group admin

demote.description: Remove a member's group admin status

kick.description: Remove a member from the group

mute.description: Close the group (admins only can send messages)

unmute.description: Open the group so every member can send messages

hidetag.description: Notify every member without visible mentions

warn.description: Give a warning to a group member

unwarn.description: Clear all warnings of a member

antilink.description: Enable the link guard in this group

antispam.description: Enable the spam guard in this group

setwarnlimit.description: Set the warning limit before a member is removed

sticker.description: Turn an image into a sticker

toimg.description: Turn a sticker into a PNG image

doctor.description: Check bot, session, and dependency health

tiktok.description: Download a TikTok video without watermark

ban.description: Block a user or group from the bot

backup.description: Create, list, and verify database backups

restore.description: Restore the database from a backup file

ai.description: Ask the AI with conversation context

resetai.description: Clear the AI conversation history in this chat

translate.description: Translate text to a target language

chatbot.description: Enable/disable the auto-reply AI in this chat

ai.unavailable: AI is not configured yet. The owner needs to set up the API key first.
ai.disabled: The AI feature is currently disabled.
ai.quotaExceeded: Your daily AI quota has been used up. Try again tomorrow.
ai.failed: The AI cannot answer right now. Please try again later.
ai.usage: Use *{prefix}{command} <question>* or reply to a message with *{prefix}{command}*.

resetai.done: 🧠 The AI conversation history in this chat has been cleared.
resetai.empty: There is no AI history stored in this chat.

summary.usage: Use *{prefix}summary <text>*, or reply to the message/text document you want summarized.

chatbot.enabled: ✅ Chatbot *enabled*. The bot will auto-reply in this chat.

menu.empty: No commands are available to you yet.
menu.footer:

alive.title: *{bot}* is alive ✅
alive.footer: Send *{prefix}menu* to see the command list.

owner.title: *{bot} Owner*

owner.footer: Contact the owner only for important matters.

mode.title: *Bot Mode*
mode.list:
*public* — everyone can use commands.
*private* — only the owner and group admins.
*self* — owner only.

maintenance.title: *Maintenance Mode*
maintenance.notice: During maintenance, only the owner and emergency commands (ping, alive, help, menu) are available.
